mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT cj.jm_cd AS jmCd , cj.cj_nm AS cjNm FROM SCM1PG t1 , SCM0CJ cj WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND cj.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd AND cj.sanghw_ymd > TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY cj.jm_cd ASC

SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.jm_cd AS jmCd , t1.pg_cd AS pgCd , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'iw') AS week , (SELECT LISTAGG(ia.fund_cd || '(' || ia.fund_nm || ')', ', ') FROM SCM1J ta , SZM0IA ia WHERE ta.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ta.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd AND ta.buy_date = TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYYMMDD') AND ia.corp_gr = ta.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = ta.fund_cd) AS fundList FROM SCM1PG t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.jm_cd = #{jmCd} ORDER BY t1.ymd ASC
